q.line: They found you at the corner
stanza: They found you in the morning
The blood was on your shoulders
They found you at the corner
Your head was doubled over
And the blood of the man
Who killed my mother with his hands
Is in me, it's in me, in my veins

partner.line: They found you in the morning

q.line: At the diner on the corner
stanza: I am sitting in the morning
At the diner on the corner
I am waiting at the counter
For the man to pour the coffee
And he fills it only halfway
And before I even argue
He is looking out the window
At somebody coming in

partner.line: I am sitting in the morning

q.line: Shelter line stretching around the corner
stanza: Shelter line stretching around the corner
Welcome to the new world order
Families sleeping in the cars in the southwest
No home, no job, no peace, no rest

partner.line: Welcome to the new world order

q.line: It is to have Runyon Avenue soldiers up in our corners
q.linePrev: To show 'em we love 'em back and let 'em know how important
q.lineNext: Their loyalty to us is worth more than any award is

partner.line: To show 'em we love 'em back and let 'em know how important

q.line: That speck of light in the furthest corner
q.linePrev: Now, see, in amongst all this space

partner.line: Then blows away over the water

stanza: With coca leaves along the border
Sweetness sings from every corner
Cars careening from the clouds
The bridges burst and twist around
And wanting something warm and moving
Bends towards herself, the soothing
Proves that she must still exist
She moves herself about her fist

partner.line: With coca leaves along the border

q.line: And I got off at the corner
stanza: The brakes howled and the bus pulled up near my house
And I got off at the corner
Pulled my sleeves down over my hands, over my hands
And I wished I was someone else
And I wished it was warmer
And when I got home, I thought about you
Like a desperate policeman, searching for clues
And I almost passed out, just then
And I shut my eyes again
Headed for the dark hillsides
In the hidden places

partner.line: And I wished it was warmer

stanza: Looking out the door, I see the rain
Fall upon the funeral mourners
Parading in a wake of sad relations
As their shoes fill up with water
Maybe I'm too young
To keep good love from going wrong
But tonight you're on my mind
So you'll never know

partner.line: As their shoes fill up with water
